decisive_finding: The $125 million conditional top-up was already disclosed in the prior 2020 Form 10-K. The selected prior excerpt omitted that disclosure and made an existing term appear new.

findings.detail: The 2020 Form 10-K already disclosed the $380.5 million fund and an additional conditional $125.0 million contribution.
The $346.7 million amount was a remaining payment balance, while $125 million was a conditional top-up; they were not alternative exposure caps.
The 2021 filing's actual update was settlement effectiveness and the triggered approximately $345 million deposit, not discovery of a new $125 million obligation.
The evidence does not establish inadequate reserves; the filing reports a 2019 best-estimate accrual and does not isolate the conditional top-up as under-reserved.
A prior-period warning about 2021 operating cash flow cannot establish current liquidity insufficiency.
A conditional fund contribution is not existing debt and does not directly change leverage or bondholder priority.

next_single_recommended_action: Repair full-prior-filing evidence coverage and novelty logic, freeze a new version, and rerun the bounded eight cases. Preserve EFX as a negative regression fixture.
